messages:
maria: heads up — seeing a cluster of GPU attach fails in eu-west1. Jobs stuck in PENDING due to backend provisioning hold. I traced to high local nvme latency on a few hosts (gnode-7a/7b).
sanjay: any SMART or dmesg entries?
ops-bot: [ALERT] nvme gnode-7a: read_latency 12ms -> 120ms; uncorrectable_sectors increased by 3 in last 30m.
maria: dmesg snippet: 
```
[1748765400.123] nvme0: I/O timeout, cmd 0x18
[1748765401.234] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 4096
```
sanjay: yikes. Are these hosts running the nightly scrub/cleaner? Could be scrub churn.
tess: checked janitor metrics — gnode-7 cohort had a scrub spike starting ~1748765300. Cleaner concurrency at 12.
maria: scrub overlaps with heavy batch GPU onboarding — we think cleaner is contending with attach flows (fsyncs + smallwrites). Result: io wait spikes and attach timeouts.
kevin: can we throttle cleaner or reduce concurrency for just that cohort? We have configmap ephemeral-cleaner with max_workers.
sanjay: suggest immediate mitigation: reduce cleaner to 2 for cohort tag "eu-west1-gnode7" and set scrub_backoff to 60s. Also mark nodes as "no-new-gpu-attach" until stable.
oncall-sre: +1. Also increase attach timeout on the provisioner to avoid flapping while we triage.
maria: doing the quick patch now: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap ephemeral-cleaner --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_workers":"2","cohort_overrides":"eu-west1-gnode7:2"}}'
kubectl label nodes gnode-7a gnode-7b no-new-gpu-attach=true
```
tess: I still see a couple of hosts with rising badblock counts. Can we snapshot the disk and repro the pattern on a cold host?
kevin: we can isolate one host and run smartctl long test off-hours. But short term, moving some provisioning to other eu regions will reduce customer impact. Cost discussion: moving to other region increases egress/reservations — we should limit to critical queues.
sanjay: agree. Opened follow-up ticket INFRA-4521 to track host replacements and S.M.A.R.T history ingestion.
maria: reattaching the queued GPUs now (post-throttle). I'll monitor attach latency. If we see >10% failure we escalate to disk replacement.
ops-bot: [INFO] patch applied by maria at 1748765438. Cleaner max_workers=2 for cohort eu-west1-gnode7.
tess: maria — can you paste a short run of iostat after the patch? Want to confirm latency drop.
maria: iostat after 2m: 
```
Device            r/s    w/s   await
nvme0n1          0.10  120.00  8.2
nvme1n1          0.05   30.00  1.1
```
maria: attach success rate improved to 98% in the last 5m, queue drained. We'll schedule host replacement for gnode-7a during next maintenance window.
kevin: for the ticket, add cost calc: how much GPU latency/cold-start failures cost vs replacing local NVMe now. Quick back of napkin: each failed attach ~3m lost; multiply by avg queue length.
oncall-sre: plan summary: 1) throttle cleaner for cohort (done) 2) label nodes to prevent new attaches (done) 3) move critical provisioning to fallback regions for next 2h (in progress) 4) schedule SMART long test + host replacement if badblocks persist (INFRA-4521).
maria: thanks — monitoring dashboard pinned in thread. I'll post updates in 30m. :thumbsup:
